Subject: Discovery follow-up: schedule technical deep dive / demo - FinPath

Hi Emily —

Thanks again for a great discovery call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- What we heard: FinPath is focused on reducing inference latency for multi-tenant scoring workflows, getting predictable per-request SLAs, and establishing procurement/security guardrails for a Q4 pilot.
- Success criteria you mentioned: <10% regression vs current models on accuracy, 95th pctl latency <250ms for single-record scoring, and an audit trail for data access.
- Suggested next step: 45–60 minute technical deep dive + demo with our runtime team to cover: architecture, quantization/latency tradeoffs, caching strategies, and security/procurement questions.

Proposed times (PDT):
- Wed 2026-08-12 10:00–11:00
- Thu 2026-08-12 14:00–15:00
- Fri 2026-08-13 09:00–10:00

I’m looping in Rishi from our platform/security team to help answer compliance questions and surface the SOC2 materials. If you have procurement on the thread, we can bring them in for the last 15 minutes to align on next steps.

Attachments: redwood-pricing-summary.pdf (summary), SOC2-overview.pdf

Thanks — looking forward to locking something in.

–Marissa
